title: Agentic browser verification toolchain
summary: Replace the current browser-checker (improvised inline check.mjs, text assertions, fail-only screenshots, passive storageState discovery) with a deterministic, repo-agnostic browser verification toolchain in claude-code-shared. Agents capture Baseline (merge-base) and Candidate (feature branch) renders per Check Spec, judge the visual delta with a vision model panel, verify behavior steps, handle auth via per-repo Auth Profiles, and stream results into a Verification Report artifact the user reviews asynchronously. Kept before/after pairs are exported to an excluded docs/visual-changes/ folder for manual PR attachment. Nothing is committed to target repos. Scope is Phase 1 (core loop), a real-app validation gate on SpawnedSapien and Quaestor-Web, then Phase 2 (derived checks, exploratory diagnosis, final sweep, review loop). Cloud execution is deferred.
problem_statement: The user manually verifies FE features because browser-checker only runs text assertions, discards evidence on pass, has no before/after comparison or visual judgment, cannot express multi-step behavior, and relies on a pre-existing storageState file that silently goes stale.
solution: Deterministic scripts (auth, runner, base server, baseline cache) driven by a declarative Check Spec, a vision-judge agent with screener plus 3-judge panel, build-code/build-runner wiring for per-task and end-of-run checks, and an async Verification Report artifact with dismiss/reject harvested by pr-revise.
decisions: Baseline is captured by replaying the same Check Spec against the feature branch's merge-base (not current main). Fallback when the base server cannot boot: pre-build snapshot of the working tree before the change is built.
Pixel diff (with heatmap) is a signal only, never a pass/fail gate. A vision model renders the Visual verdict.
Visual verdict values are expected, regression, unexpected, uncertain. 'as_intended' is not used.

Judging flow: zero-diff shortcut (diff under noise threshold and expected_visual_change none => expected, no model call); otherwise one Sonnet screener; any non-expected screener verdict goes to a 3-Sonnet-judge panel with 2-of-3 majority; no majority => uncertain. No Opus escalation.
Judge rubric is delta-only: flaws already present in the Baseline are not findings. It is for regressions and diff checks, not aesthetics.

Desktop regression blocks the task and feeds the judge rationale into the build-runner retry loop. Mobile regression is downgraded to needs_eyes. unexpected and uncertain become needs_eyes and never block. A failed behavior expect step always blocks.

Default viewports are desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 for both SpawnedSapien and Quaestor-Web. Tablet only when a spec requests it. Dark mode only if the app supports it and the diff touches styles/tokens. Per-repo viewport override lives in repo-policy.json.

Auth uses a per-repo Auth Profile stored in claude-code-shared resources/repo-policy.json (browser_auth block), never in the target repo. Strategy order: project-owned auth setup, then API login, then scripted form login, then human-seeded session. Ship project-owned setup and API login now.
Shared tooling stores no credentials. Creds stay in the project's .env.local or macOS Keychain.
Auth state per Role is stored at ~/.cache/claude-browser-auth/<repo>/<role>.json with chmod 600.
A Freshness probe runs before every check; stale state regenerates; unrecoverable auth yields skipped: auth_expired, never a failure.
Auth Profiles support a Seed hook of pre-check calls so Baseline and Candidate render against identical data (e.g. Quaestor enable-all-feature-flags and setup-test-users-and-entities).

Quaestor-Web auth: TESTING_BYPASS_LOGIN endpoints (/user/setup-test-users-and-entities/, /user/authenticate-test-firm-user/, /user/authenticate-test-company-user/, /user/enable-all-feature-flags/). SpawnedSapien auth: existing tests/auth.setup.ts and tests/auth.admin.setup.ts with E2E_* creds in .env.local.

A browser check is defined by a declarative Check Spec (role, viewports, ordered steps: goto/click/fill/waitFor/capture/expect, masks, expected_visual_change) using role/text locators, executed by one deterministic shared script (browser-verify.mjs) identically against Baseline and Candidate. Agents no longer improvise check.mjs.
An Exploratory pass (live browser via chrome-devtools MCP) runs only on a failed step or uncertain verdict and produces diagnosis only, never a verdict.
Check Specs are ephemeral, live in excluded docs/browser-checks/ scaffolding, and are never committed or promoted to committed e2e tests.
Verification instrumentation never touches target repos (no committed specs, no in-repo auth config, no asset branches, no new CI jobs), consistent with repo-policy.json excludes.
The runner owns determinism: disabled animations, frozen clock, network idle wait, fonts loaded, and spec-declared masks for dynamic regions.
One Base server per build run serves the merge-base SHA from a fresh read-only worktree on an offset port, shared by all checks in the run, torn down at run end.
Baselines are cached keyed by (spec hash, base SHA, viewport, role) in ~/.cache/claude-browser-verify/.
Candidates are captured per task inside the build-runner loop; parallel worktrees each get their own candidate port and share the Base server.
A Final sweep re-runs every Check Spec from a build run against the final branch head at run end to catch cross-task regressions.

Two coverage triggers: Planned checks authored by to-tasks from seed intent, and Derived checks produced after TDD passes when the diff touches FE files or API response shape and no Planned check exists.
Derived checks are authored by an Opus-tier agent (check-spec-deriver). Their expected_visual_change is unknown, so any visible change resolves to needs_eyes.
Derived checks map changed files to routes (Sapien Vite router, Quaestor Next app/pages dirs), cap at 3 routes per shared component, and list the rest as Unchecked consumers in the report.
Backend-only diffs get no check, except API serializer/response-shape changes, which derive a check on the consuming page.
Evidence retention is fixed (no flags): expected with expected_visual_change none is discarded; expected with intentional change, unexpected, uncertain, and regression are kept.
Results stream into one private Verification Report artifact per build run, created at run start and filled live. needs_eyes items are listed first. The run never pauses for review.
Report actions are dismiss and reject-with-note only, stored in the artifact DB. Rejects are harvested by pr-revise as an additional feedback source alongside PR comments.

No /verify-publish skill. Publication is automatic at build-code run end: every kept Baseline/Candidate pair plus a paste-ready pr-snippet.md is written to docs/visual-changes/<branch-slug>/ with numbered filenames. The user attaches images to the PR manually.
docs/visual-changes/ is added to the exclude list of all 4 repos in repo-policy.json. clean-scaffolding deletes a branch's docs/visual-changes/ folder (no archive) once its PR is merged.
The PR body gets a one-line verification summary (e.g. '5 expected, 2 needs_eyes').
No /verify-ui skill. debug spawns the refactored browser-checker directly with a Check Spec.
No opt-in flags or modes (no --attended, no --evidence always).
Tiers: browser-checker Haiku, visual-judge Sonnet, check-spec-deriver Opus, browser-explorer Sonnet.
browser-checker takes a verify host input; only local is implemented now. The seam exists for a later amp-orb host.
Build order: Phase 1 core loop, then a validation gate, then Phase 2. All in this one effort.

Validation gate: run the toolchain on a real feature branch in SpawnedSapien and in Quaestor-Web locally. Pass = auth works for 2+ roles, before/after pairs are produced, judge verdicts look sane, report renders. Phase 2 starts only after it passes. No unit tests for the infra scripts; real-app validation replaces them.
e2e-runner and to-e2e-tasks are left untouched as a separate committed-e2e path.
implementation_decisions: Phase 1 new scripts in claude-code-shared/scripts/: browser-auth.py (ensure --repo --role), browser-verify.mjs (run --spec --base-url --state --out; captures, pixelmatch diff + heatmap, console errors, manifest JSON), base-server.sh (up|down; merge-base worktree, offset port e.g. 5173->6173, health poll, reuses repo-policy worktree_links for env files), baseline-cache.py (get|put).
Phase 1 new contracts (md + schema): check-spec, visual-verdict, and browser-check-result bumped to v2 (capture pairs, diff ratios, step results, console errors).
Phase 1 new agent: agents/visual-judge.md (Sonnet), registered in agents/registry.json and resources/model-tiers.json.

Phase 1 edits: browser-checker rewrite (orchestrates scripts, returns v2, stays Haiku); build-runner step 4 (checker, screener, panel, mobile downgrade, needs_eyes, regression rationale into retry loop); build-code (auth ensure, base server up/down, report artifact create, Publication, PR summary line, needs_eyes status handling); to-tasks writes a full Check Spec into browser_verify; task contract browser_verify becomes check-spec and gains needs_eyes status; repo-policy.json excludes + browser_auth + viewports blocks; app-launch-detection.md storageState discovery replaced by browser-auth.py plus base port offset rule; debug uses Check Spec and v2 contract; Verification Report artifact template in resources/ with DB capability.

Phase 2: agents/check-spec-deriver.md (Opus), agents/browser-explorer.md (Sonnet + chrome-devtools MCP), build-runner wiring for both, build-code Final sweep, pr-revise reject harvest from the report DB, clean-scaffolding delete-on-merge for docs/visual-changes/, registry and model-tiers sync for the new agents.

Quaestor-Web local dev: Django backend 127.0.0.1:8000, Next.js frontend; existing state file client/playwright/.auth/user.json. SpawnedSapien: Vite 5173, Supabase cloud, state in playwright/.auth/user.json and admin.json.
testing_decisions: No unit tests for claude-code-shared scripts/agents (user rule). Validation is a real-app gate on SpawnedSapien and Quaestor-Web feature branches between Phase 1 and Phase 2.
risks_and_tradeoffs: Two app servers per run (Base + Candidate) plus up to 4 parallel candidate ports increases local resource use, especially for Quaestor's Django + Next stack.
Final sweep adds run time; accepted because it is the only cross-task regression catch.
Derived-check file-to-route mapping may miss consumers beyond the 3-route cap; mitigated by listing Unchecked consumers.
Mask lists must be maintained in specs for dynamic regions or the diff becomes noise.
Artifact publishing from an unattended build-code run may hit permission prompts; not verified in this session.

deferred.text: Amp orb verify host for Quaestor-Web (amp-verify.sh adapter: fresh Base orb at merge-base per run, candidate orb per branch, amp threads continue -ox with --stream-json, amp sync results back).
deferred.rationale: User wants the local toolchain validated first. Amp docs leave code delivery, prompt-driven execution, script delivery, and amp sync scope unverified; amp CLI not installed locally.
deferred.context: Quaestor-Web already has team-maintained orb config in .agents/ (setup, resume, orb, ensure, docker pulling amp-orb-ecr:Quaestor-Web-Dev). Start with a 1-2 hour spike to answer the four unknowns. Base orb must be fresh per run, never long-lived.

deferred.rationale: Both current apps bypass SSO via project-owned setup; build only when an app needs them.

out_of_scope.rationale: Instrumentation in repo; Auth Profiles live in repo-policy.json.

out_of_scope.text: Orphan verification-assets branch or secret gist for PR images, and browser-automated GitHub image upload.
out_of_scope.rationale: User attaches images manually from docs/visual-changes/.

User will not use ad hoc verify; publication is automatic and rejects flow through pr-revise.

out_of_scope.text: Opt-in flags such as --attended or --evidence always, and an inline attended review gate.
out_of_scope.rationale: User never passes flags; runs stay unattended.

out_of_scope.text: Committed golden screenshots and pixel-threshold pass/fail.
out_of_scope.rationale: Churn, flakiness, and cannot distinguish intent (ADR-0004).
Checks are for regressions and diffs only.

success_metrics: Validation gate passes on a real feature branch in both SpawnedSapien and Quaestor-Web: auth for 2+ roles, before/after pairs produced, sane verdicts, report renders.
further_notes: Glossary terms recorded in claude-code-shared/CONTEXT.md: Baseline, Candidate, Visual diff, Visual verdict, Check Spec, Planned check, Derived check, Unchecked consumer, Exploratory pass, Verification Report, needs_eyes, Publication, Base server, Verify host, Final sweep, Auth Profile, Role, Freshness probe, Seed hook.
ADRs: claude-code-shared/docs/adr/0003 (instrumentation stays out of target repos), 0004 (visual verdict is a judged delta), 0005 (browser auth is project-owned first).
